description: MINIMAL TEMPLATE: one scalar, one point, one sweep, a for-all constraint, one objective, one bound. Swing arm seen from above: an arm hinged at H on the wall y = 0 turns from 20 to 160 deg; it must clear the plant at every angle and its swing must stay within depth_max of the wall; make the arm as long as possible. Solved with the default 64 starts: feasible, 22 of 65 runs at the optimum L = 98.59876 cm, H = (0.2, 0) m; plant active, depth 98.61903 cm <= 100 cm.

how_to_edit.params: Every number you may want to change, by name. A string may carry a unit ("3cm", "2deg", "84%"); a JSON number is SI (m, rad).
how_to_edit.params.gap: smallest allowed distance between the arm and the plant
how_to_edit.params.arm_w: width of the arm (a known size, so a param, not a design variable)
how_to_edit.params.depth_max: the bound of criterion 'depth'; try other values with --bound depth=90 (cm, the criterion's unit)
how_to_edit.let.arm: the moving shape: a box in its own frame (origin at the hinge, x along the arm), placed at H and turned by the sweep a
how_to_edit.display: GUI drawing only; no effect on the solve
how_to_edit.delete: this how_to_edit object is ignored by geomsolver; delete it when you are done

wall.note: EDIT: fixed scene. An open polyline has no inside: clearance to it is unsigned

plant.note: EDIT: an obstacle; x, y = centre, r = radius, in metres

H.note: EDIT: a point the solver chooses; domain = where it may go (segment, box, rect, polygon or circle); value = start, [x, y] in metres

L.note: EDIT: a number the solver chooses; min/max are hard limits; value is SI (0.6 = 60 cm) whatever the unit

a.note: EDIT: the motion parameter, here the arm angle; use min 0, max 1 when the motion has no natural parameter

constraints.name: plant
constraints.note: EDIT: a hard requirement; forall a = at every angle of the motion. One row per obstacle

criteria.name: length
criteria.note: EDIT: the ONE objective (role minimize or maximize); every other wish is a bound

criteria.name: depth
criteria.note: EDIT: a bound: role max means expr <= bound, here at every angle (max_over). Role min means expr >= bound
